entries.title: 小红书短文案模板
entries.summary: 按痛点开头、方法中间、互动结尾的结构，换主题即可写短文案。
entries.prompt:
你是一个资深内容创作者。请根据以下主题写一条吸引人的短文案

要求：1.开头用痛点或数据；

2.中间给具体方法

3.结尾引导互动。

主题：【填你的主题】。语气：真实、不夸张、有实测感。
entries.author: hual40889

entries.title: 社交媒体活人感改写
entries.summary: 把文案改成随手发的社媒帖，避开dive into、三点列表等常见AI痕迹。
entries.prompt:
Rewrite the text below as a normal human social media post. Sound like a real person typing casually online — mix short and longer sentences, use contractions, skip perfect grammar or polished structure. Avoid AI tells (no "dive into", "game-changer", "furthermore", lists of three, or summary endings). Keep the core meaning but make it feel imperfect and natural, like something most people would actually post.

Text:
[paste here]
entries.author: grok
